claim_label: approximate reproduction; independent detector slot diagnostic on frozen Total-Text crops

scientific_choices.choice: The paper uses DeepSolo as fallback but does not specify independent word-slot filtering of PARSeq crops. This detector-slot diagnostic is outside the strict path.
Reuse the frozen Total-Text TEST crop/PARSeq predictions and the already qualified ResNet-50 DeepSolo candidate/runtime.
The low detector threshold 0.05 probes recall; 0.4 is the frozen DeepSolo config default. Cross them with predeclared crop-slot box IoU controls 0.1, 0.25, 0.5. No TEST outcome chooses a setting.

Use DeepSolo polygon envelopes as slots, retain all overlapping crop memberships, and make a one-crop-per-slot/one-slot-per-crop maximum assignment using the geometric mean of crop score and box IoU. DeepSolo transcription is ignored.
Run qualified DeepSolo sequentially in an isolated host Python 3.8 subprocess with CUDA; record each image's peak VRAM and timing.
The available checkpoint is a Total-Text model-zoo candidate; transfer to other datasets and performance of a detector with no Total-Text training remain untested.
